instructions: 1. Say "Run workflow:method-change-code" with request, in plain words, the code change or fix you want.

2. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:method-change-code, input {request}) and walks its steps in order: name-question-delete, contact-reality, test-a-design-against-every-case, do-it-completely, plan-only-what-helps.
3. Each step starts one child workflow with the same request; read the {run_id, changed} it hands back.
4. The last step, plan-only-what-helps, writes only the plan that helps and does it; check the change on the real running path.
